reason: Phase 10 scope review confirms that Goldfinch is fundamentally a DeFi lending protocol rather than a CeFi lending/yield platform. Goldfinch governance GIP-87 and its July 7, 2026 follow-up establish an orderly Goldfinch Prime wind-down, full Prime investor redemption, contract pause, and legacy V1 recovery-only maintenance. Those facts are historically relevant but do not override CYA's fixed README scope, which focuses on CeFi lending/yield and explicitly does not prioritize DeFi lending protocols or pool-level records. Keeping Goldfinch in the active queue would repeatedly consume CeFi-growth research capacity and risk mixing protocol/pool outcomes with platform-level customer outcomes. This decision is scope-based, not an adverse assessment of Goldfinch, and may be revisited only if CYA formally expands its scope.
